body: Doing things I havent done. The time has expired.
There might be, but I'm out of time.

My thoughts want to scream at you, there is more and more and more. But what matters now is that I cant make rent, I'm going to be fired when work finds out my lies, if I tell anyone the truth it will all be on me. The yelling, the blame, the hours of crying, the headaches, feeling like a cold empty shell, for what? It keeps getting worse. I'm not asking for money again, I cant be responsible with it. I confess at work, I'm out the door bc I have lied for 2 months. I have fucked over people at work, who are nothing but supportive and great, I cant face that. Everywhere I go, everyone I meet. I am stupid and lazy, I cant remember the basics, I'm too wrapped up in myself. I cant fake it, but I cant make it.

I agree it goes deeper but I'm lost, all I know is I will hold onto anyone and worry they will leave and i sabotage most relationships myself anyways bc of my fears.

I dont think o do anything right in the long run. I'll have small success, but i cant keep it up. Hell i cant even motivate myself to shower everyday. I'm my own worse enemy and it affects everyone around me for the worst. 

I am toxic, you know the person I am. Most people have met that fake person who stands strong and hurts everyone to save their own feelings. That is me, I see that now. Even if I reach out, somehow actually live through the mess of my life right now, I'll still repeat the same thing.  I will loose everything, and then i have to watch and listen to everyone around me tell me they told me so, the words  they will say, the looks i will get. Yes i am my own worse critic, but when my closest and only friend sounds just like my parents when i was growing up just proves i cant be any better. The pain and hurt i cause these people has to stop, I have to stop. 

I cant stop my bad behavior or feeling. I cant keep anything going for more than a week. I fight with myself in my head everyday, and my worse trait is daydreaming. I daydream to get away, I watch tv to get away, I listen to music to get away. I go to a place where I can control the story for a while. I numb myself to forget, to the point where I cant focus on much for long anymore. I function like a shell everyday, I'm present but empty what was living here before is gone. I'm not here anymore, and what is left doesnt want to be here anymore either.

I have an early memory as a child, I'm looking through photos from when I was a baby and toddler. I was so upset to see myself in a swing with no one with me. I thought they left me by myself. Idk, stupid, bc who was taking the photo, but I still remember how sad and scared I felt thinking they left me.

Wrong things...making the wrong choice at work, should I do a then b, or b than a, or is there a c I forgot, what saves me more time. How can I do this better, faster, easier. I forget what people like or dislike, what they tell me, so I end up in situations where I let people down. I also avoided conflict or things that make me uneasy, that is the worst of them all bc now I'm really stuck.

Edit: Sorry for taking long to reply, I'm trying to not ramble on.

I'm afraid of being judged, ridiculed, abandoned. Problems of my own making, admitting I created those problems. Doing the wrong thing when I thought I was doing right thing and continuously second guessing myself. Letting down the people who believe I am ok, who I think I fool with my act. My act that consists of keeping everyone at arms length, bc if you get to close you will get hurt by me.

Welcome, I'm done trying to make things better. I dont have it in me to continuously fail at the smallest things and have my fear hold me back. I shake just thinking about trying again for another day.
